name: Security Identification And Amount 2
definition: Specifies the current valuation of a security.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Value of the outright investment according to the CCP’s system of record.

FinancialInstrumentType.name: Financial Instrument Type
FinancialInstrumentType.definition: Type of a financial instrument: an equity, bond or other.

DebtIssuerType.name: Debt Issuer Type
DebtIssuerType.definition: Type of debt issuer if Financial Instrument Type is Debt.

DebtIssuerTypeRule.definition: If FinancialInstrumentType is equal to value 'BOND', then DebtIssuerType must be present.

ConditionalPresenceOfBond.definition: The Debt Issuer Type must be present if and only if Financial Instrument Type equals 'Bond'
